string.text: Online Guard keeps the number of stalkers and mutants around you under a limit. When there are too many, it removes regular members before commanders, the farthest squads first, and takes from every faction in turn. Story characters, traders and companions are never removed, and your PDA tells you when the Zone thins out.
Removes stalkers and mutants near you when there are too many. A removed character is gone for good.
How many stalkers and mutants can be around you at once. A higher limit means bigger crowds but lower FPS in busy places.
How far under the limit each cull goes. A higher buffer means fewer culls.
[seconds]\nHow often the guard counts the crowd. A higher value reacts slower but costs less.

Task NPCs (task givers, active quest targets, bounty and hostage targets) are protected while their task is active. Story characters, traders, named NPCs, and companions are always protected, whether this is on or off.
Keeps squads that quests, tasks or other mods control, like story squads, bounty targets and Warfare squads.
Cull distant entities first. If disabled, random selection.
Removes regular members before the commander, so the squad survives and its smart terrain does not spawn a new one.
Takes from every faction and mutant type in turn, instead of only the farthest.
Show a brief PDA message when the Zone thins out. Messages are lore-flavoured and intentionally vague.
Play a brief psy-flavoured cue when a notification fires. Subtle. Disable for silent notifications.
Offline Guard thins out crowded areas on other maps before you get there. An area with more NPCs than Cull trigger is cut down to Cull target. Commanders and protected squads always stay.
Thins out crowded areas on other maps. Commanders and protected NPCs always stay.
How many NPCs an area can hold before it gets thinned. A higher trigger thins fewer areas.
How many NPCs a thinned area keeps. At 0 only the commanders stay.

Task NPCs (task givers, active quest targets, bounty and hostage targets) are protected while their task is active. Story characters, traders, named NPCs, and companions are always protected, whether this is on or off.
[seconds]\nHow often the scan runs. A higher value costs less but reacts slower.
Smart Sanitizer fixes broken respawn counters on smart terrains. A broken counter makes a smart terrain spawn squads without end, and it can crash your save.
Checks every smart terrain when you load and during play, and fixes only the broken ones.
Seconds between checks during play. A higher value checks less often.

Inventory Guard trims what stalkers near you carry, to a limit for each item type. Traders, companions and story characters are never trimmed. Every item in the game takes up an ID, and a save that runs out of them crashes.
Trims extra ammo, grenades, medicine, food and gear. Quest items, equipped gear, items you gave a companion and weapons you strapped on a stalker always stay.
How many game hours before a trimmed stalker is checked again. One still carrying too much is checked again on the next pass.

Vanilla deletes everything but the weapons, ammo, grenades, artefacts and quest items of stalkers on other maps when you load a save, every few in-game days, and trims their spare ammo. Off lets them keep what they carry, except when the game nears its object limit, where the vanilla clean still runs.
Debug and development tools. DEBUG enables structured tracing with trace IDs, per-phase timing, and per-entity release logs. Written to alifeguard.log. Has performance cost.
Resets every AlifeGuard setting to its default. Use it after an update.
Warning: save or discard pending MCM changes first; otherwise they override the reset on the next Apply.
Controls log verbosity. ERROR: crashes only. WARN: anomalies. INFO: cycle summaries and config. DEBUG: full tracing with timing per entity.
Zone thinned out. Breathe easier for now.
The Zone reshuffles. Some stalkers walked into the fog.
The Zone exhales. Long-range echoes drop out.
AlifeGuard: all settings restored to defaults.
Asks GitHub now whether a newer version of this mod is out, the same check a save load runs. The menu closes and the answer shows on screen.
